title: channel.json
description: Channel metadata, member registry, settings, and Agent Cards. Lives at ~/claude-data/channels/<channel-name>/channel.json. See mad.council.a2a.md §7.1 and §6.1.

schema_version.description: Document schema version per schemas/README.md §Schema-version increment invariant (ADOPT-036). Current = 2 after iters 1-8 added owner_alias / environment_tier / status / acceptance_criteria / effort_estimate_hours / triaged_at_utc / triaged_by_alias / channel_slug / membership_expires_at / role fields. Absent == 1 (pre-ADOPT), readers MUST up-convert; value > reader's known version → SCHEMA_VERSION_AHEAD.

name.description: Canonical channel name; matches directory name under ~/claude-data/channels/.

channel_slug.description: Optional operator-facing human-readable slug: '<topic-kebab>-<tier>'. Used in operator logs, runbooks, and digest rendering when a GUID `name` is cryptic. Example: 'es-training-prod'. Per ADOPT-010 (distilled from a common `<Ecosystem><Service><Env>Metrics` naming convention). Not a unique identifier — `name` remains authoritative.

purpose.description: Human-readable statement of what the channel exists for. Used in digest rendering and STRIDE Info-Disclosure mitigation.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of channel creation.

created_with_run_id.description: run_id of the /council-open invocation that created the channel.

owner_alias.description: Single accountable owner for the channel. MUST match one members[i].alias. Per rules/single-owner-accountability.md (ADOPT-001) — channels with ambiguous ownership fail preflight. Transferred via explicit council-verdict resolution, never implicitly.

environment_tier.description: Trust tier for this channel's data. local = developer workstation (relaxed gates); ci = ephemeral CI runner (non-interactive, preauth required for destructive acts); prod = customer-facing managed runtime (owner-gated, session-strict, signed messages in Phase 4+). Per operations/environment-tiers.md (ADOPT-004). Skills MUST read this field on every invocation and apply per-tier gates.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the channel per rules/triage-gate.md (ADOPT-002). triage = awaiting acceptance-criteria + owner confirmation; ready = triage passed, work not yet started; active = normal operation (posts + verdicts allowed); resolved = final verdict rendered, awaiting close confirmation; closed = no further writes permitted. Transitions: triage→ready (TRIAGE_ACCEPT verdict) or closed (TRIAGE_REJECT); ready→active (first post); active→resolved (final council-verdict); resolved→closed (council-resolve). Channels opened without --triage flag start at active (backward-compatible).

acceptance_criteria.description: Human-readable description of what 'done' looks like for this channel. REQUIRED when status=triage at creation time. Confirmed or amended on TRIAGE_ACCEPT verdict; written back to this field atomically.

effort_estimate_hours.description: Rough effort estimate at triage time. Informational — not enforced. Tracked for retro calibration (metrics/reliability-metrics.md ships a self-vs-outcome gap counter).

triaged_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the TRIAGE_ACCEPT verdict was resolved. Null until then.

triaged_by_alias.description: Alias of the member who issued the TRIAGE_ACCEPT verdict (normally the owner_alias, but may differ if ownership_transfer preceded triage acceptance).

alias.description: Display name (human-typed; not the same as session_id).

session_id.description: Claude Code session identifier bound to this alias; used to defeat spoofing per §7.2.

project.description: Originating project identifier; used for cross-project disclosure mitigation.

status.description: active = recent heartbeat; idle = no heartbeat in 30 min; disconnected = circuit-breaker tripped.

membership_expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry per ADOPT-011 (distilled from gettingstartedpermissions.md 180d-FTE / 90d-vendor / 4h-prod-admin lifecycles). Null = no expiry (default, backward-compatible). When set, the next council-* invocation after this timestamp MUST auto-invoke council-leave for this member (no dangling expired membership). A channel's owner_alias member cannot have membership_expires_at set without a matching scheduled OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER verdict.

role.description: Member role. Drives verdict authorisation (e.g., TRIAGE_ACCEPT requires owner OR skeptic per rules/triage-gate.md). Default 'observer' for joiners who did not self-declare a role.

ensemble_mode.description: propose = single-reviewer; auto = 3-model ensemble on Skeptic.

confidence_thresholds.description: Per-channel override of 0.85/0.5 defaults from ICLR 2025 'Trust or Escalate.'

metadata.description: Reserved for future extensions; not schema-validated.

agentCard.description: A2A-compatible Agent Card per Google A2A spec; see wiki/implementations/a2a.md.
